data.name: Unlucky Mummy
data.detailed_description:
Before you stands a sarcophagus, wherein lies a mummy, and 12 relics of the ancient gods. The Ancient Egyptians believed that, after death, we live on simultaneously within the body of a mummy and in the this way, the mummy exists in two states at once: both alive and dead. The same is true for the 12 relics: they both exist and do not exist while the sarcophagus remains closed. Scientists call this 'superposition'.

To resurrect the mummy, you will need to find all 12 relics

Each time you open the sarcophagus, one simple rule applies:

  • There is a 25% chance that you will find a new relic.

  • There is a 75% chance that the sarcophagus will be empty, and all the relics you have found thus far will disappear.

  • The odds of finding all 12 relics in a row are 1 in 16,777,216.

Upgrade your odds

Eeach time you make a successful discovery, you will receive golden scarabs, which you may spend on upgrades:

  • an increased chance of success

  • increase the speed of opening the sarcophagus

  • increase the base reward from relics

Unlock 6 unique endings, each revealing new layers of the story and rewarding you with a powerful Glyph that permanently alters future playthroughs.

Unlucky Mummy is a test not only of your luck, but also your perseverance.

The 12 relics may be found in the first few minutes of the game, or they may never be found.

Because, after all, the sarcophagus is subject to the impartial laws of quantum randomness.

data.short_description: Unlucky Mummy is an incremental clicker where your task is to open a sarcophagus with a curse on it. Starting with a 25% chance of success, can you find 12 relics in a row to resurrect the mummy?
data.supported_languages:
English*, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Simplified Chinese, Korean, Polish, Portuguese - Brazil, Russian, Turkish, Japanese, Ukrainian, Lithuanian
*languages with full audio support

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 or more
  • Processor: Intel i3 4th generation or equivalent
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Most dedicated GPUs should work.
  • Storage: 400 MB available space

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: macOS Ventura or later
  • Processor: M1 or Intel equivalent
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: M1 or Intel equivalent
  • Storage: 400 MB available space
